2610.13669.title: A Step Harder, Not a Step Too Far: The Benefits and Limits of Curriculum Difficulty Progression in GRPO
2610.13669.paper_summary: Curriculum learning typically organizes training samples from easy to hard. In GRPO, medium-difficulty samples are attractive for online selection because they are more likely to yield informative group-relative learning signals, and prioritizing them can improve training efficiency. However, it remains unclear whether persistently selecting such samples also leads to the strongest final model performance, or whether training can benefit from progressing toward harder samples. Meanwhile, sample difficulty changes as the policy evolves, so fixed difficulty estimates can become misaligned with the current policy. We therefore re-estimate sample difficulty under the current policy and, inspired by the easy-to-hard principle of curriculum learning, design and evaluate a staged curriculum that progressively shifts the active difficulty band toward harder samples. Experiments on GSM8K show that persistent medium-difficulty selection does not achieve the strongest observed performance. Across three random seeds, progressing to a moderately harder difficulty band improves test accuracy to $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$, compared with $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ for the fixed-medium curriculum. However, further progression to a harder difficulty band reduces accuracy to $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$. These results show that staged difficulty progression can outperform persistent medium-difficulty selection, but its benefit is non-monotonic. Effective GRPO curricula can therefore benefit from progressing beyond medium difficulty, while avoiding excessive progression toward overly difficult samples.}
2610.13669.paper_summary_zh: 課程學習通常將訓練樣本從簡單到困難進行組織。在 GRPO 中，中等難度的樣本對於在線選擇具有吸引力，因為它們更有可能產生信息豐富的群體相對學習信號，並且優先選擇它們可以提高訓練效率。然而，目前尚不清楚持續選擇這些樣本是否也會導致最強的最終模型性能，或者訓練是否可以從向更困難的樣本進展中受益。與此同時，隨著策略的演變，樣本的難度會發生變化，因此固定的難度估計可能會與當前策略不一致。因此，我們在當前策略下重新估計樣本難度，並受到課程學習的從易到難原則的啟發，設計並評估一個分階段的課程，逐步將活動難度帶轉向更困難的樣本。對 GSM8K 的實驗顯示，持續的中等難度選擇並未達到觀察到的最強性能。在三個隨機種子中，向中等更困難的難度帶進展將測試準確率提高到 $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$，而固定中等課程的準確率為 $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$。然而，進一步向更困難的難度帶推進會將準確率降低到 $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$。這些結果表明，分階段的難度進展可以超越持續的中等難度選擇，但其好處是非單調的。因此，有效的 GRPO 課程可以從超越中等難度中受益，同時避免過度向過於困難的樣本進展。
